ratings_why.fun: One pile of Kits with three pulls on it (fight HP, missiles, stats) gives a real choice every turn, and the board visibly swells into a tide.
ratings_why.distinct: An off-board Burrow that refills each fight and a global Kit size are fresh; Kit makers themselves are familiar token-tribe fare.

verdict_why: The tribe reads well overall, but "front unit" and Identical Cousin need a wording fix before players can read them for sure.

points.text: "Your front unit" is undefined: F1 only, or your first living front-row unit in reading order? The Front Lemming and Brother Onward both hinge on it; define it once as a keyword-style term.
Identical Cousin doesn't say who picks the Kit and the unit when several are next to it, or what "plain" keeps. Say "choose" and "base stats and text, no buffs".
The Burrow is the whole tribe but lives off the board; show it as a count of tents on the hero portrait for both players, so the Tide's real size is readable before the fight.
Tally reads as a generic gold card; tie her to the Herd ("gain 1 gold per 5 Kits in your Herd, at most 2") so the census fox is actually counting lemmings.
Ferrywife's text could name the fantasy: "Half your Burrow crosses the Wide Water" reads the trade at a glance and lands the lake-crossing story.

standouts.why: Ole the Learned makes Kits rain on the enemy: the sky-falling myth turned into a one-line, instantly readable effect.
Brother Onward's passing, growing Banner is "whoever is in front leads" played out on screen.
Gerd the Shouter: tiny Kits that hurt giants back, the tribe's picking-fights-with-giants theme in four words.

weakest.why: Tally's full-board check has nothing to do with lemmings and works in any late comp.
Snowbed Nester is a plain token maker with no lemming flavour beyond its name.
Herding Council is a flat spend-for-stats card that overlaps Raft-builder and Ferrywife without a council twist.

flags.note: "New front unit" has the same gap; with Onward it is probably the Kit in the same slot, but the text doesn't say.
Who chooses the Kit and the unit, and what a "plain" copy keeps.
Herald with Litter Keeper doubles the Burrow each turn up to the caps; worth a sim with goldens.
Golden Cantor on a long Onward chain with Old Mother Lemen could put very large in-fight stats on one unit.
